$comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for every assistant-platform package in this directory (issue #16614, ADR-0383, ADR-0385). Name, logo and MCP URL are defined here once; scripts/generate.py renders every package from this file and scripts/check.py fails when a package, or the tool list, drifts from it. The bank-assigned display name and logo shown on the consent screen and in the app (ADR-0385 D2.3) must be these values; the customers-realm client entries are to be generated from this file when they exist. Values starting with OWNER-SUPPLIED are placeholders only the owner can fill.

identity.description: Read your OpenBank accounts, balances, transactions, statements and payment confirmations, and draft payment proposals that you approve yourself in the OpenBank app.
identity.longDescription: Connect your OpenBank account to ask about balances, recent transactions, closed statements and the confirmation details of payments you already made. The assistant can also draft a payment PROPOSAL. A proposal is never a payment: nothing leaves your account until you open the OpenBank app and approve that exact proposal with strong customer authentication. The assistant can never pay, change limits, add trusted payees or change security settings. Data you ask about is sent to the assistant platform's own provider. You can see and revoke every connected assistant in the OpenBank app. Limitations: personal accounts only; IBANs and counterparty names are masked; transaction history is limited to 90 days and statements to 12 months.

server.$comment: The ONE official MCP URL every package references. PLANNED: no route to openbank-mcp-service exists (ADR-0383 'Until then no route to mcp-service is created'; gitops/components/mcp has no Ingress/HTTPRoute). The path /mcp is the real JAX-RS path (McpEndpoint @Path("/mcp")); the host is the existing public customer edge host and is an assumption until the route slice decides it.

scopes.$comment: Read + propose only (ADR-0383 D3/D4, ADR-0385 D1). Scope NAMES are proposed here; no realm defines them yet.

admission.$comment: Per ADR-0385 D1. Only a path where the platform authenticates as a confidential client at BOTH token and refresh (Tier H) or a local client with DPoP (Tier L) is admitted. Public-client paths are 'not supported by the bank'.

openai-chatgpt-directory.status: candidate; vendor docs verified 2026-11-17, bank side not built

anthropic-claude-directory.tokenEndpointAuthMethod: client_secret (Anthropic-held, entered by the owner in the developer portal)
anthropic-claude-directory.status: candidate at ADR-0385 Tier H MINIMUM (secret, not private_key_jwt); vendor docs verified 2026-11-17, bank side not built

notSupportedByTheBank: Claude custom connector added by URL (uses Anthropic's CIMD as a public client, or DCR; never the portal secret)
Claude Code (own CIMD public client + loopback redirect; DPoP not documented) - Tier L requires DPoP
ChatGPT/Codex custom MCP server typed by URL with token_endpoint_auth_method none
Codex local CLI OAuth, until verified to be either the hosted confidential client or a DPoP-capable local client
Any Dynamic Client Registration path (DCR is off, ADR-0383 D1)

tools.$comment: The customer-channel tool set: the subset of openbank-mcp-service McpToolRegistry that ADR-0383 D4 allows (query.*.readonly + propose.payment). Customer-facing descriptions are written here (the registry's current text describes the governed-agent PSD2-consent path, which ADR-0383 D3 says this channel does not use). scripts/check.py fails if a name, capability, input property or required argument drifts from the registry, or if a registry tool is neither included nor excluded.
